questions.question: What did Vikings call their long, narrow wooden ships?
questions.explanation: Longships were light and fast, and could sail up rivers as well as across seas.

questions.question: In which year did the Battle of Hastings take place?
questions.explanation: William of Normandy defeated King Harold at Hastings in 1066.

questions.question: Which English king was killed at the Battle of Hastings in 1066?
questions.explanation: Harold died at Hastings, fighting the Norman army.
